title: Conjecture register
summary: A paper folio's open-problem register: one `folio-conjecture-register/v1` node per conjecture block, tracking its formal-vs-identification classification, DMN-computed status lifecycle, Lean stub, critical-path theorems that assume it (`lean-formal-graph` reverse edges), and work-traceability attempts.
description: A paper folio's conjecture register — one `folio-conjecture-register/v1` JSON node per open problem (`schemas/conjecture-register.ts`), pairing the source `conjecture()` block (`conj:...`) and its `conjectureKind` (`formal` vs `identification`) with its DMN-computed status (`open`, `attempted`, `proved`, `disproved`, `superseded`), Lean stub, critical-path theorems that assume it (`assumedBy`, computed as reverse edges over `lean-formal-graph`), and work-traceability attempts (`attempts[]`).

avatar.reads: a question mark on a ledger page, in the scientific-paper profile's hue: open problems tracked until proved, refuted or superseded

rationale: Bean folio-assistant-ckej (recorded from the qou work-plan analysis, 2026-10-04): `ConjectureBlock` carried only an optional `lean` field, leaving no place for a paper's open problems to record their status lifecycle, reverse-edge impact on critical-path theorems, or work-traceability attempts. `holds: "state"` because a conjecture's status and attempts evolve as proof work proceeds; `recordsWork: false` because active work is claimed on the bean in `beans/` that `attempts[].beanId` references, never counted twice.
